capabilities: stabilize bold rendering around punctuation and brackets in CJK/English text
render \(...\) and \[...\] math in the Live Preview layer
apply decorations without modifying note content
disambiguation: Despite the name, it also handles Live Preview rendering of \(...\) and \[...\] math, not just bold text.
extras: Manual installation only (copy manifest.json, main.js, versions.json into the plugins folder); README warns compatibility can depend on other editor-rendering plugins that patch the same ranges.
intentEvidence: Live Preview Bold Fix stabilizes rendering behavior in Obsidian Live Preview
problem: Obsidian Live Preview renders bold inconsistently around punctuation and brackets in mixed CJK/English text and does not preview \(...\)-style math.
summary: CodeMirror decoration patch that stabilizes bold rendering in Live Preview and adds preview-layer rendering for \(...\) and \[...\] math.
